title: Non Stick & Work Perfectly!
text:

product_metadata.title: Crumpet Rings Nonstick 3.5" - English Muffin Rings for Fluffy Muffins - Set of 4 Crumpet Molds – Metal Baking Rings - No Leak Sturdy Egg Ring Set - Made in the UK
features: No Leaking or Sticking - Do you want perfect shaped crumpets or pancakes? Than look no further than these perfect cooking rings. Oven and frying pan safe, these superior quality rings are a must for English Muffins, Sourdough Crumpets, Pancakes and Flans.

Mutiple Uses - Sturdy, well made and easy to clean. These burger rings are quality carbon steel made in the UK and non-stick. These egg rings are perfect for eggs in a breakfast sandwich or round mini pancakes.

Perfect Heat Distribution - Making perfect crumpets every time has never been so easy. Each nonstick pancake ring heats evenly allowing for the perfect rise. Taller than other rings, they have the perfect depth and thickness. For serious baking tasks!

Specifications - Approx Size: 3.35" x 1.25". Easy to clean, each egg ring mold is dishwasher safe. With thorough drying, these pastry rings will not bend, deform or rust. Use them time and time again to make perfectly round fried eggs or Japanese pancakes.

Made in England – Each metal cooking ring is made in the UK, using the best manufacturing processes with emphasis on quality and craftsmanship. They have a premium quality robust finish, designed to last.
